---
title: "分析"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)

# CSVを読み込む
raw <- read.csv(
  file.choose(),
  header = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "CP932",
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  na.strings = c("", "-", "…", "－")
)

# 分析対象とする支出項目
items <- c(
  "消費支出",
  "食料",
  "外食",
  "光熱・水道",
  "被服及び履物",
  "教養娯楽"
)

# 支出項目を抽出して縦長に変換
df <- raw %>%
  filter(V6 %in% items) %>%
  select(V6, V7:ncol(raw)) %>%
  rename(項目 = V6) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -項目,
    names_to = "列番号",
    values_to = "支出"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    月番号 = as.integer(sub("V", "", 列番号)) - 6L,
    年月 = as.Date(
      seq(
        as.Date("2000-01-01"),
        by = "month",
        length.out = ncol(raw) - 6L
      )[月番号]
    ),
    支出 = parse_number(as.character(支出))
  ) %>%
  select(年月, 項目, 支出) %>%
  arrange(年月, 項目)

# 確認
head(df)
glimpse(df)
```

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = 年月, y = 支出, color = 項目)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "家計の支出項目別推移",
    x = "年月",
    y = "支出額（円）",
    color = "支出項目"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
df %>%
  filter(項目 != "消費支出") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = 年月, y = 支出)) +
  geom_line(color = "skyblue") +
  facet_wrap(~ 項目, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "支出項目別の推移",
    x = "年月",
    y = "支出額（円）"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  group_by(項目) %>%
  arrange(年月, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    前年同月支出 = lag(支出, 12),
    前年比 = (支出 / 前年同月支出 - 1) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 食料支出の前年比
df %>%
  filter(項目 == "食料") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = 年月, y = 前年比)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "食料支出の前年同月比",
    x = "年月",
    y = "前年比（%）"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
